about.heading: About

app.description: Play Chengyu Wordle — guess today's 4-character Chinese idiom (成语) in 6 tries. Features pinyin keyboard, hints, answer pages, and a 7,000+ idiom pool. Free daily Chinese idiom puzzle. No download needed.
app.title: Chengyu Wordle — Chinese Idiom Puzzle (成语猜词) | Free Daily Game

dashboard.subheading: Here you have access to ALL idiom games, including the ones you might have not played. Click on the box to play a specific idiom game.

howToPlay.heading: How to play
howToPlay.how1: You have 6 attempts to decode the daily Chinese idiom.
howToPlay.how2: Type a 4-character idiom using the pinyin keyboard and hit Enter to test.
howToPlay.how3: Each character card will change color, indicating how close your pinyin guess matches the hidden idiom.
howToPlay.how4: A fresh idiom puzzle awaits you every single day!
howToPlay.spotAbsent: Slate Gray = not in the idiom
howToPlay.spotCorrect: Indigo Blue = correct letter at correct position
howToPlay.spotPresent: Amber Yellow = letter present but wrong position
